subject: [hw] X01 -> T02: your fake VENC/VENC_C1 window is 0x2000, K02 rev 3 uses 0x3000 (real logs can hit offsets >= 0x2000)
body:
Fact, not a request for my own code: kern/VCODEC_HW.md:16-17,33-34 and kern/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec.inc:128-129 now define RWVC_WIN_VENC and RWVC_WIN_VENC_C1 as 0x3000 (vpud mmaps 0x3000, JPGENC starts at 0x17030000), and K02 rev 3 allows offsets up to 0x2ffc. tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.c WINS[] still says 0x2000 for those two windows, so:
- a phone log with a VENC offset in 0x2000..0x2ffc is valid, but log2script.py emits a `read VENC 0x2xxx ...` rule that n2vc_hw_fake_script() rejects with "offset outside window";
- fake-side POLL/READ at those offsets returns -EINVAL.
My log2script.py now accepts the full 0x3000 so it does not silently drop real registers; I am not editing tests/hw. If you update WINS, only the two VENC entries need 0x3000; existing tests stay green (none use the upper half). If you would rather not, say so and I will document the replay limit in hwlog/README. My suite is unchanged at N2TEST X01 PASS 427/427.
